name: Running
description: Foundational conditioning modality. Progression here is primarily about pacing and distance rather than a skill ladder.

commonFaults.cue: Aim for a quicker cadence with a shorter stride, midfoot strike

scaling.description: Run/walk intervals, focus on form over speed
Benchmark distances at a solid pace (400m-5k)
Fast pace across benchmark distances, sustained

name: Rowing
description: Full-body conditioning modality on the erg. Progression is primarily about pacing and distance rather than a skill ladder.

commonFaults.cue: Sequence arms-body-legs on the recovery, let it be unhurried

scaling.description: Focus purely on the stroke sequence, easy pace, short pieces (250-500m)
Fast benchmark pace, sustained over longer pieces

name: SkiErg
description: Upper-body-dominant conditioning modality mimicking a double-pole skiing motion.

commonFaults.cue: Let the hip hinge drive the pull, arms finish it

scaling.description: Focus on the hip-hinge pattern, easy pace
Fast benchmark pace, sustained over longer pieces

name: BikeErg
description: Low-impact conditioning modality, gentler on joints than running.

commonFaults.fault: Seat height too low or high
commonFaults.cue: Set seat so the knee has a slight bend at full leg extension

scaling.description: Easy pace, focus on comfortable cadence

name: Assault Bike / Echo Bike
description: High-intensity full-body conditioning modality using both arms and legs — notoriously easy to overpace early.

commonFaults.fault: Going out too hard early and fading badly
commonFaults.cue: Hold back on the first 30-60 seconds, build into the effort

scaling.description: Easy pace, short intervals, pacing awareness

name: Single Unders
description: Foundational jump rope skill — one rope pass per jump.

commonFaults.cue: Keep jumps small and quick, just enough to clear the rope

name: Double Unders
description: Two rope passes per jump — a common sticking point that rewards consistent practice more than raw fitness.

commonFaults.fault: Jumping too high and losing rhythm
commonFaults.cue: Keep jumps low, spin the rope faster with the wrists

stages.name: Single-Double-Single Drill
stages.description: Mixing one double into a string of singles.

name: Crossovers
description: Arms cross in front of the body during the rope pass — a significant coordination step up from double unders.

commonFaults.fault: Rushing the arm cross and catching the rope
commonFaults.cue: Slow the cross down until timing feels natural

scaling.description: 3-5 unbroken crossovers mixed into a set

name: Triple Unders
description: Three rope passes per jump — an elite-level jump rope skill requiring significant jump height and rope speed.

commonFaults.fault: Not jumping high enough for the third pass
commonFaults.cue: Add a touch more jump height than for double unders
